summary: Kinetic Seas Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on October 20, 2026 furnishing a press release announcing commercial availability of three enterprise AI software platforms—MaluDB, MaluOS, and MaluMail—offered under dual open-source and enterprise subscription models. The company also disclosed federal trademark applications with the USPTO for the MALUDB, MALUOS, and MALUMAIL marks. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or closing date is stated. This is a routine product-launch and IP-protection disclosure, not a special situation; there is no deal or risk-arbitrage angle to monitor.
